meta_description: Plaster Walls Manchester offers expert plastering, skimming, and rendering. Fast turnaround, quality finish. Call 07887 593367 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Internal walls, external rendering, or artexing — Plaster Walls delivers flawless finishes on time, every time.
services_subhead: From small patch repairs to full property renders, we handle residential and commercial work with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Skimming & Boarding
services.desc: Smooth, flawless finishes ready for decoration. We board ceilings, patch damp damage, and skim over old textured surfaces for a modern look.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant renders protect your property and enhance kerb appeal. We apply cement, acrylic, and silicone coatings with precision and finish.

services.title: Artexing & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Bold textures add character and hide imperfections. We create stippled, swirled, or patterned finishes tailored to your taste.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Crack Filling
services.desc: No job too small. We fix cracks, holes, and damaged areas quickly without the cost of full redecoration.

services.title: Cornicing & Coving Installation
services.desc: Decorative cornice and coving work adds elegance to ceilings and walls. Professional installation and finishing included.

services.title: Damp & Water Damage Remediation
services.desc: We plaster over treated damp areas and water-damaged walls, restoring strength and appearance to your interior.

about_pullquote: Every wall we finish reflects our name — perfect plaster, every time.
about_para_1: Plaster Walls was founded on a simple principle: deliver expert plastering without the premium price tag. With over 15 years in Manchester's construction industry, we've built a reputation for clean sites, meticulous attention to detail, and finishes that last. Whether you're a homeowner, property manager, or developer, we treat your project as our own.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up on time, getting the job done right, and leaving no mess behind. Our repeat customer rate speaks volumes — most of our work now comes from referrals and long-term clients who trust us to handle their trickiest plastering challenges.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Needed the lounge re-skimmed before Christmas. Called on a Tuesday, they came out Wednesday morning, quoted fair, and finished by Friday. Brilliant finish, no mess, and they even hoovered up after themselves. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a damp patch on the bedroom wall that needed proper plaster repair. The lad who came out explained exactly what he'd do, no pressure, no upsell. Job took 3 hours, looks perfect now. Will definitely use again for the hallway.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: External render on the front of our 1930s semi was crumbling. Got 3 quotes — Plaster Walls' price was competitive and their previous work in our area looked fantastic. Finished in 2 weeks, weatherproof, and they matched the existing texture perfectly.
reviews.author: Martin T.
